column1: # Test packages ci/go_race_shard.awk places first, each on the then-lightest shard, heaviest first (CHAOS-13422): the five heaviest

# packages of the go-quality test leg by median wall (517-792 s, ci/go_test_weights.tsv; internal/cigates/testshard checks they are the five heaviest) must not share a shard, so with five test shards each
# runs beside lighter packages only. Format: package<TAB>reason. Key = import path relative to the module root.
# One heavy row per test shard (internal/cigates/testshard checks the count, that each row names a real package, and that they land on distinct shards),
# plus apart rows (internal/cigates/testshard names each one and the package it must not share a shard with), placed after the heavy rows,
# plus the serial package, placed last, onto the then-lightest shard.
